preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fi <= n and fi != i for i, fi in enumerate(friends, start=1))
preconditions.description: Each student's best friend must be a valid student index and cannot be themselves.

preconditions.expression: all(si in {1, 2} for si in sexes)
preconditions.description: Each student's sex must be either 1 (boy) or 2 (girl).

postconditions.description: The number of pairs t must equal the length of the pairs list.

postconditions.expression: e == sum(1 for a, b in pairs if sexes[a-1] != sexes[b-1])
postconditions.description: The number of boy-girl pairs e must equal the count of pairs with different sexes.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in pairs)
postconditions.description: All pairs must consist of valid student indices.
